slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了

真恒继续说道：
“当时寺内有些人支持，也有人反对，说这是坏了祖宗的规矩。
但我信你，所以先在护持堂和镇岳堂试行。
试了半年，效果出奇的好。
那些原本懒散的弟子，为了挣贡献点，开始主动接任务、练武、研究禅法。原本修炼进度慢的，为了攒够兑换丹药的点数，开始拼命苦修。”
他站起身，走到窗前，负手而立，望着窗外的天色，声音中带着几分感慨：
“两年后，护持堂的明劲期弟子，平均修为提升了两个小境界。
五年后，第十七代‘如’字辈的弟子里，开始有人突破到了暗劲后期，甚至暗劲圆满。
到了今年，如字辈里已经出了三个化劲期的高手。”
真武在一旁插嘴道：
“方丈师兄说得没错。
我那镇岳堂里，有个叫如意的弟子，原本天赋平平，资源有限，修炼了十几年还在暗劲中期晃荡。
贡献点制度一出来，他像变了个人似的，天天接任务，天天练武，两年时间硬生生冲到了暗劲圆满。
居然成了咱们真如寺如字辈里第一个化劲期的弟子。”
真玄听到这里，心中也是一动。
如意这个名字他有印象，是个沉默寡言的年轻人，平日里话不多，但做事极踏实。
他能在两年内从暗劲中期冲到化劲，固然有贡献点制度的激励，但更重要的，是他自己的努力。
真恒走回真玄面前，居高临下地看着他，声音变得严肃：
“所以，真玄，你今天必须把这贡献点领了。

你作为这套制度的创立者之一，自己都不领，那其他弟子会怎么想？”
真玄沉默良久，终于点了点头，道：“好，我领。”
真恒这才露出笑容，拍了拍真玄的肩膀，道：“这就对了。”
境空在一旁记完了账，抬起头来，道：“记上了。三千贡献点，已入真玄师侄名下。”
真玄摇了摇头，道：“多谢师叔。”
境空点了点头，也不多问。
真武见事情办妥，便拱手道：“方丈师兄，我先回去了。身上的伤还没好利索，得再运功调养几日。”
真恒点了点头：“去吧。好好养伤，别急着修炼。”
真武应了一声，转身大步流星地走了。
真恒看着真武的背影消失在院门外，这才转过头，看向真玄，用眼神示意他跟上。
他带着真玄走出善功堂，沿着一条僻静的小径，朝后山走去。
两人一前一后，走了约莫一炷香的功夫，来到一片竹林之中。
竹林不大，只有几百棵，但棵棵都有碗口粗，竹竿青翠欲滴，竹叶在风中沙沙作响。
竹林深处有一间小小的茅屋，是真恒平日里闭关静修的地方。
他推开茅屋的门，走了进去，在蒲团上坐下，指了指对面的蒲团，示意真玄也坐下。
真玄盘膝坐下，看着真恒。
真恒沉默了片刻，缓缓开口：“真玄，你如今已是抱丹初期，可有什么不明白的地方？”
真玄想了想，道：“倒是有几处。真元运转之间，虽然已经圆融无碍，但总觉得还差了点什么，说不上来。”
真恒点了点头，道：
“抱丹境和化劲境不同。化劲境是劲随意走，收发自如，但归根结底，还是在‘用’上下功夫。

抱丹境则不同，抱丹之后，重心就转到了‘养’上。

Zhenheng continued:
“At that time, some people in the temple supported it, while others opposed it, saying it broke the ancestral rules.
But I believe in you, so I will try it out in Huzhu Hall and Zhenyue Hall first.
After trying it for half a year, the effect is surprisingly good.
Those originally lazy disciples began to take the initiative to take on tasks, practice martial arts, and study Zen methods in order to earn contribution points. The progress of cultivation was slow at first, but in order to save enough points to exchange for elixirs, he began to practice hard. "
He stood up, walked to the window, stood with his hands behind his hands, and looked at the sky outside the window, with a bit of emotion in his voice:
"Two years later, the average cultivation level of the Ming Jin period disciples of the Protector Hall has improved by two small realms.
Five years later, among the disciples of the seventeenth generation of ‘Ru’, some began to break through to the late stage of An Jin, or even to the perfection of An Jin.
By this year, there have been three masters in the Ruzi generation. "
Zhenwu interjected from the side:
"Brother Abbot is right.
In my Zhenyue Hall, there is a disciple named Ruyi. He originally had mediocre talents and limited resources. After practicing for more than ten years, he is still wandering in the middle stage of Anjin.
As soon as the contribution point system came out, he seemed to be a different person. He took on tasks every day and practiced martial arts every day. In two years, he suddenly reached Anjin perfection.
He actually became the first disciple of our Zhenru Siru generation to reach the energy transformation stage. "
When Zhenxuan heard this, his heart moved.
The name Ruyi had an impression on him. He was a taciturn young man. He didn't talk much on weekdays, but he was very down-to-earth in his work.
He was able to rush from the middle stage of Anjin to Huajin in two years. Of course, he was encouraged by the contribution point system, but more importantly, it was his own efforts.
Zhenheng walked back to Zhenxuan, looked at him condescendingly, and his voice became serious:
"So, Zhenxuan, you must receive this contribution point today.
As one of the founders of this system, if you don’t accept it yourself, what will other disciples think? "
Zhenxuan was silent for a long time, then finally nodded and said, "Okay, I'll take it."
Zhen Heng then smiled, patted Zhen Xuan on the shoulder and said, "That's right."
Jingkong finished writing down the account on the side, raised his head and said, "It's recorded. The three thousand contribution points are in the name of the nephew Zhenxuan."
Zhenxuan shook his head and said, "Thank you, uncle."
Jingkong nodded and didn't ask any more questions.
Seeing that the matter was done, Zhenwu cupped his hands and said, "Brother Abbot, I'm going back first. The injuries on my body haven't healed yet, and I need to use my energy to recuperate for a few more days."
Zhen Heng nodded: "Go ahead. Recuperate well and don't rush to practice."
Zhenwu responded, turned around and strode away.
Zhenheng watched Zhenwu's back disappear outside the courtyard gate, then turned his head and looked at Zhenxuan, gesturing for him to follow him with his eyes.
He took Zhenxuan out of Shanggong Hall and walked along a secluded path towards the back mountain.
The two of them walked in tandem and arrived at a bamboo forest in about the time it took to burn an incense stick.
The bamboo forest is not big, with only a few hundred trees, but each one is as thick as a bowl. The bamboo poles are green and green, and the bamboo leaves rustle in the wind.
There is a small thatched hut deep in the bamboo forest, which is where Zhenheng retreats and meditates on weekdays.
He pushed open the door of the hut, walked in, sat down on the futon, pointed to the futon opposite, and motioned for Zhenxuan to sit down as well.
Zhenxuan sat down cross-legged and looked at Zhenheng.
Zhen Heng was silent for a moment and then slowly said: "Zhen Xuan, you are in the early stage of holding the pill now, is there anything you don't understand?"
Zhenxuan thought for a while and said: "There are a few things. Although the true energy is running smoothly, I still feel that there is something missing, which I can't explain."
Zhenheng nodded and said:
"The Baodan realm is different from the Huajin realm. In the Huajin realm, the energy can move freely and be sent and received freely, but in the final analysis, you still have to work hard on 'use'.
The situation is different in the Dan Bao realm. After Bao Dan, the focus shifts to ‘nurturing’.
